The SSL handshake failure occurred because the debug build connects to the local development server (`https://10.0.2.2:8443/`) which uses a self-signed development certificate (`dev-ca/shelftap-dev-ca.pem`), but the Android application lacked a Network Security Configuration trusting this certificate in debug builds.

### Changes Made

1. **Added Certificate Resource**: Copied the development CA certificate to [shelftap_dev_ca.pem](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/res/raw/shelftap_dev_ca.pem) so it is packaged as a raw resource (`@raw/shelftap_dev_ca`).
2. **Created Network Security Config**: Added [network_security_config.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml) with `<debug-overrides>` to trust `@raw/shelftap_dev_ca` during debuggable builds while leaving release builds trusting standard system CAs.
3. **Updated Manifest**: Added `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` to the `<application>` tag in [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c2-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L6-L9).
